svg.title: Long-Range IoT Teleoperation System — End-to-End Architecture
svg.desc: Browser commands use a cloud Redis and WebSocket control path, a separate LoRa gateway, and the robot motor driver. Gateway status returns through Redis. Robot video uses a Radxa to MediaMTX RTSP path and WebRTC browser playback.
svg.text: Gateway-originated status; the robot receiver has no radio acknowledgement.
Direct Internet uplink through MediaMTX · separate from command delivery
LoRa frame: 16 bytes · AES-256-CBC · CRC32 · duplicate sequence check
Field range reported from project test
